text:
sam: Heads up — canary charts are slower after yesterday's client rollout, LCP +1.1s on heatmap and sparklines. Observability shows main-thread parse spike. https://telemetry.redwood/trace/abc123 :frowning:

deploy-bot: canary-deploy-1749999800 completed by @ci :white_check_mark:

jen: Repro locally?

sam: Repro on canary in EU region, happens for a couple of pages. Quick devtools trace attached.

amar: Did we change chunking/splitpoints? I tweaked splitpoint config yesterday.

sam: Diff of production bundle sizes (canary vs baseline):
```
vendor.js  +120KB
heatmap.chunk.js  +76KB
telemetry-client.js  +40KB
```

leo: That telemetry-client bump looks suspicious — it now eager-imports the new router telemetry wrapper which pulls embedlib.

rachel: Can we lazy-import telemetry per-route? Also FYI routing PR changed kvcache invalidation policy which might be clearing prefix cache and causing extra prefetches.

jen: Confirmed: routing-policy change added route weights & affinity tweaks -> more cold starts for kvcache. Telemetry shows repeated module parses matching those cold starts.

sam: Canary logs snippet:
```
[12:34:56] Parsing main-thread: heatmap.chunk.js
[12:34:56] Module parse cost increased 8x compared to baseline
[12:34:57] Repeated fetch: GET /api/metrics?route=heatmap&cache=miss
```

amar: Oof — I lowered kvcache TTL from 5m -> 30s to reduce stale UI in quick-rollout. Didn’t think about parse churn. My bad.

leo: Proposal: revert the routing weight change and restore kvcache TTL to 5m in canary. Also revert telemetry wrapper eager import.

sam: Assigning @amar to revert TTL patch and open a lightweight revert PR.

amar: On it — sending PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/489

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for PR 489 (user: @amar)

rachel: Also let's add a telemetry counter for module-parse-per-session and an alert if it spikes >5x so we catch regressions faster.

jen: Good call. I'll add the metric + alert in telemetry infra. Small PR incoming.

sam: If PR 489 merges and canary stabilizes we can promote. Monitoring for 30m after rollout. Thanks all :thumbsup:

leo: Follow-up item: update eng-platform docs about kvcache TTL tradeoffs and prefetch affinity implications.

sam: Filed ENG-2743 for docs update.

deploy-bot: canary rollout succeeded for PR 489 at 1750000028 :tada:

sam: Canary LCP back to baseline (~-1.0s). Will leave monitoring for 24h then close. Closing notes: avoid eager telemetry imports in common chunks; be conservative about TTL changes that affect prefetch affinity.

jen: Nice catch everyone.

rachel: Adding a short blurb to the rollout playbook about checking kvcache TTL impact on module parse.
